evidence.quote: We propose a $38 million class fund with automatic payments to all identified members. Fees would be paid separately, subject to court approval, and any amount not awarded would go to the class.
The parties are $1 million apart on the class fund, with all other terms settled.

summary: Plaintiff’s counsel raised fees in its opening proposal. The fee terms were settled while the parties were still negotiating the class fund. The transcript does not show a fee-for-relief tradeoff or a misleading court declaration.
